predictions.mechanism: Industrial production missed consensus, led by a manufacturing decline, but the release is low impact and the equity response is mediated by yields, oil and expiry flows.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp post-release yield move or broad cash-index breakout opposite the forecast would invalidate the residual call.
predictions.counter_case: Weak growth can lower Treasury yields and support equity valuations, especially tech, while falling oil reduces inflation pressure.
